summary: Only the 4-door crew cab and the bonnet are armoured: protection against 7.62x54R B-32 API at 30 m and splinters, plus a mine-protected floor (manufacturer); modelled as ~12-14 mm RHA-equivalent (high-hardness steel, est. 8-10 mm actual). The gun mount, crew working positions, ammunition containers, fuel tank and tyres are unprotected (3-10 mm structural steel), so artillery splinters, drones and HMG fire disable the gun or start a charge fire. Crew are protected only while travelling in the cab; when deployed they work in the open.
frame: armor.js: metres, x right, y up, z forward, origin on the ground at the hull centre; faces in mm RHA-equivalent vs a horizontal shot
